transcript.speaker: Naomi Fletcher
transcript.content: Micah, can I be blunt? I’ve noticed you spend a lot of time with that group of high schoolers and I’m worried people might read it the wrong way and it could create awkward judgment or rumours. I get that you probably enjoy hanging out or mentoring them, but you might avoid unnecessary stigma by balancing that with friends closer to your own age. I’m telling you this because I care and don’t want something avoidable to hurt you socially.
